svg.aria-label: How it works as a pixel web: session history feeds the Observer, which writes observations into the memory ledger in the session; the Reflector reads them and writes reflections back, each citing the observations it preserves; after a reflection, when observations are over target, the Dropper retires observations, which stay in the session; the compaction summary is rendered from the ledger with no summarization model
